annotation.title_clean: Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Advanced AI system
annotation.title_en: Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Advanced AI system
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, DG CONNECT (Shaping Europe's digital future)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission library page announcing the G7 Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Organizations Developing Advanced AI Systems (30 October 2023), with a download link. The non-exhaustive, living principles build on the OECD AI Principles and promote safe, secure and trustworthy advanced AI, including foundation and generative models.
key_provisions_or_claims: Principles aim to promote safe, secure and trustworthy AI worldwide
Target organizations developing advanced AI, including foundation and generative models
Non-exhaustive living document building on OECD AI Principles
Apply to all AI actors across design, development, deployment and use
Accompanied by a voluntary Code of Conduct agreed by G7 leaders
